terminalSequence.description: A terminal escape sequence Claude Code emits for the hook: only OSC 0, 1, 2, 9, 99, 777 and BEL. Anything else makes the field ignored. Interactive sessions only, and not from an async hook.

worktreePath.description: HTTP hooks only: the absolute, normalized path of the created worktree, not passing through a symlink.

title: WorktreeCreate hook output
description: Returns the created worktree's path. A command hook does not print JSON: it prints the path as the last non-empty line of stdout, with everything else on stderr. Only an HTTP hook returns this object. Any non-zero exit, or no path, fails creation. Claude Code discards continue, systemMessage, stopReason on this event.
